images.prompt: A premium 3D educational scientific illustration for a Korean teacher webinar slide. One isolated atomic model centered in a square composition, genuinely transparent background. Restrained palette: warm orange #FF9228, pearl white electron beads, subtle neutral gray. Clean studio lighting, softly shaded physical materials, crisp readable silhouettes. Sophisticated classroom science illustration, not flat SVG, not an icon, not a wireframe CAD screenshot. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO labels, NO watermark, NO glow fog, NO decorative sparks, NO hands. Match a black presentation with orange accents. Generous empty transparent margins, all parts fully inside the image. This is a conceptual historical model illustration with deliberately exaggerated sizes, not a real atomic photograph or accurate scale. THOMSON PLUM PUDDING MODEL ONLY: a large translucent amber-orange sphere representing positively charged material distributed throughout the whole volume. Show four small pearl white electron beads embedded at separate visible locations THROUGHOUT THE INTERIOR of the orange sphere; use clear translucent material to make embedded beads legible, some near front, some deeper. Absolutely NO compact central nucleus, no central glowing ball, no external electron orbit, no rings. The crucial visual distinction is distributed positive material with embedded electrons.
